## What's new in 1.9.3

A fix for the update server.

- **Fixed: the update server crashed** (`fatal error: sync: unlock of unlocked mutex`) whenever a release was added from GitHub with **copies kept on the server**. It restarted a few seconds later, signed out of the admin page, and the copies were never downloaded. This affected the update server on every system (Linux, Raspberry Pi, OpenWrt, Windows, AppImage). A test now adds a release with copies kept, end to end.

Upgrading the update server: `./deploy.sh user@host --version 1.9.3`, or install the new `server-…` package over 1.9.2; settings, devices and versions are kept. Then add the release again with the copies you want. The apps and the gateway are the same as 1.9.2 apart from the version number.
